tools.name: handoff_submit
tools.description: REQUIRED FINAL CALL of a worker pane (spawned with a task): your VERY LAST action, or the orchestrator waits forever — idle output is not completion. summary = 1–2 sentences, the CONCLUSION itself (never "I wrote X"); write the full answer in your own pane first. For code/deploy/wiring work fill `evidence` (commands + exit codes, files) so the orchestrator can review. AFTER this call your turn is OVER: one short closing line, no restating, no second call for the same task.

paneId.description: Submitting pane. Omit = the caller pane.

summary.description: 1–2 sentences (≤280 chars): the conclusion itself, in the task's language; short answers verbatim. >400 chars is auto-condensed (original → fullText); >1500 refused.

status.description: done | blocked | error | progress (non-terminal note: no wake).

artifacts.description: Structured output only (paths, ids, results) — never a copy of your prose.

to.description: paneId to wake instead of your spawner (when the briefing says "report to pane-N"). Unknown target → spawner.

briefId.description: briefId of the brief-file you executed (delegation by pointer).

evidence.description: Proof for the review gate: references, not prose. Big diffs/logs → evidenceFile.

verify.description: Command or file:line that proves it.

evidenceFile.description: Absolute path holding the full diff / logs.

deployed.description: One line: how deploy was proven.

wired.description: One line: how wiring was proven.

tested.description: One line: how tests were proven.

fullText.description: Complete long answer (>280 chars), stored for handoff_list full:true. Never travels by default.

attach.description: (system) Set by the Overclock close hook — workers never set this.

sessionId.description: (system) CLI session id captured by the close hook.

transcript.description: (system) Transcript path captured by the close hook.

tools.name: handoff_list
tools.description: Read worker results (task-granular: 1 pane = N tasks, ids "h-N"). Default = tasks delegated to YOU in your mission. The wake line is the result; `full:true` with `ids` returns the stored fullText. Do not poll: results are delivered to you when the worker submits.

panes.description: Filter by paneId — all of that worker's tasks, newest first.

ids.description: Filter by task id ("h-N"). Required to read fullText.

delegator.description: Audit filter: everything delegated BY this paneId, pending included.

scope.description: caller_mission (default when the session has a mission) | caller_workspace | all_workspaces.

allowCrossCaller.description: Bypass caller/mission scoping — the global registry.

tools.name: pane_spawn
tools.description: Open agent pane(s) in the Overclock grid — a "pane" is THIS Overclock object, NOT a tmux/terminal split, window or shell job. ONE pane: `prompt` (task delivered at birth; the pane wakes already executing it) OR `idle:true`. N panes: ONE call with `panes:[…]`, never N calls. Every config field is optional (the pane clones your CLI/account/model/effort/cwd). Returns paneId(s). Do not narrate — call, then END YOUR TURN; the worker's handoff wakes you.

agent.description: CLI host. OMIT unless the human named a CLI — omitted = clone of the caller.

model.description: Model id. Omit to inherit the caller's. Valid ids: overclock_list kind=models.

prompt.description: First task, delivered at birth (the pane boots already executing it). REQUIRED unless idle:true. A POINTER ("executa TASK/items/X.md"), relayed faithfully — never the order to open panes.

idle.description: True ONLY for a deliberately EMPTY pane. Mutually exclusive with `prompt`.

effort.description: Reasoning effort at spawn (claude/codex low..max). Set it HERE, never via /effort after boot.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory. Defaults to the caller's workspace ROOT — pass it explicitly when spawning from a worker.

autoCloseOnHandoff.description: Close the pane 30s after a clean done handoff. Default false.

delegateOnly.description: Pure-delegator orchestrator: execution tools stripped. Use with squadRole:"orchestrator".

squadCallable.description: Agents this orchestrator may spawn via persona. [] = discovered at runtime.

persona.description: Catalog agent name to embody (its prompt/CLI/model/skills).

resume.description: Resume a CLOSED worker with its context: task id "h-N" or old paneId. Combine with prompt (the follow-up).

missionId.description: Bind to a specific mission. Normally omit — spawns inherit the caller's.

workspacePath.description: Workspace the pane belongs to (registered folder). Omit = the caller's; declare it when spawning from outside a pane (Arms/bot).

allowedSkills.description: Hard skill whitelist for this pane (gate blocks the rest).

expectSiblings.description: Legacy hint (total panes of this wave) — prefer `panes:[…]` in ONE call.

toolProfile.description: MCP tools the pane SEES: worker (handoff/read/list/media/spawn/write) | orchestrator (+wait/close/mission/squad/clarify) | full. Inferred from role when omitted.

task.description: Harness (Ultra): the task TYPE; the app picks model/effort/skills and says so in the receipt. Explicit fields win.

allowChildSpawns.description: How many panes THIS pane may spawn. Omit = 0 for a worker; pass N only for a sub-orchestrator.

expect.description: Delivery contract: artifacts must match `expect.schema`; mismatches go back to the worker up to `expect.retries` (default 1), then land as blocked.

panes.description: N panes in ONE call (never N calls). Each entry takes the same fields as a single spawn.

prompt.description: First task for THIS pane. REQUIRED unless idle:true.

idle.description: True ONLY for a deliberately empty pane.

agent.description: CLI host. Omit = clone of the caller.

effort.description: Reasoning effort at spawn. Omit to inherit.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory inside the workspace.

workspacePath.description: Workspace of THIS pane (default: the wave's / the caller's).

allowChildSpawns.description: How many panes this pane may spawn.

autoCloseOnHandoff.description: Close 30s after a clean done handoff.

tools.name: pane_write
tools.description: Type text into an existing pane and submit it (a new task for a pane that is already alive). One pane: `paneId`+`text`. Several: `writes:[{paneId,text},…]` in one call. Briefing is a POINTER ("executa TASK/items/F-016.md"), never an inline dossier. Never spawn+write the same pane: pane_spawn `prompt` already delivers the first task.

text.description: Text to type and submit. Relay the human's ask faithfully; briefing is a POINTER, never an inline dossier.

brief.description: Full briefing persisted as a file; the pane gets only a pointer line (delegation by pointer).

allowCrossMission.description: Required (true) to reach a pane of another mission.

allowCrossWorkspace.description: Required (true) to reach a pane of another workspace.

text.description: Text to type. Omit when using `brief` (pointer mode).

brief.description: Full briefing persisted as a file; the pane gets a pointer line.

submit.description: Default true. False leaves text parked in the target input.

writes.description: Several panes in one call: [{paneId, text|brief}].

tools.name: pane_read
tools.description: Read a pane's terminal tail (one: `paneId`; several: `panes:[ids]`). Worker results arrive by handoff — read a pane only to confirm boot/state or inspect a sibling; polling pane_read in a loop re-reads your whole context each turn (measured: 159M cache-read tokens).

lastN.description: Trailing lines after compact filtering. Default 80, max 1000.

includeRawLines.description: Debug only: include the raw filtered lines.

preferHandoff.description: Default true: return the OVERCLOCK_HANDOFF block when present instead of the raw tail.

handoffOnly.description: Return only the handoff block (empty when absent).

allowCrossMission.description: Required (true) to reach a pane of another mission.

allowCrossWorkspace.description: Required (true) to reach a pane of another workspace.

match.description: Optional substring to detect in this pane output.

tools.name: pane_wait
tools.description: Block until a pane is output-idle (`paneId`, cap 15s — BOOT CONFIRMATION ONLY) or until panes match/finish (`panes:[…]`, fallback for agents that cannot handoff_submit). NEVER wait for a worker result here: delegate and END YOUR TURN — handoff_submit wakes you.

paneId.description: Single pane: wait until output-idle (cap 15s — boot confirmation only).

poll.description: Return the current status immediately, without blocking.

timeoutMs.description: Max wait. Single pane: default/cap 15000. `panes`: default 30000, max 600000.

allowCrossMission.description: Required (true) to reach a pane of another mission.

allowCrossWorkspace.description: Required (true) to reach a pane of another workspace.

match.description: Substring that marks this pane complete.

panes.description: Several panes: [{paneId, match?, caseSensitive?}] — completes on idle/done/dead, or when `match` appears (after the submitted prompt echo).

pollIntervalMs.description: Internal polling interval. Default 100, min 50, max 5000.

lastN.description: Trailing lines inspected per pane. Default 120.

includeTail.description: Include compact terminal tails in the snapshots.

scope.description: caller_mission (default when the session has a mission) | caller_workspace | all_workspaces.

tools.name: pane_list
tools.description: List panes with status (idle/running/done/dead), CLI, model and mission. Default scope: the caller's mission (else workspace). Status is the liveness signal — prefer it to reading terminals.

scope.description: caller_mission (default when the session has a mission) | caller_workspace | all_workspaces.

tools.name: pane_close
tools.description: Close pane(s): `paneId` for one, `paneIds:[…]` for several in ONE call. Closing is silent (no death wake); collect the handoff first.

scope.description: caller_mission (default when the session has a mission) | caller_workspace | all_workspaces.

allowSelfClose.description: Required (true) to close your own pane.

allowCrossWorkspace.description: Required (true) to reach a pane of another workspace.

allowCrossMission.description: Required (true) to reach a pane of another mission.

paneIds.description: Several panes in ONE call (never N calls).

tools.name: pane_attach
tools.description: Mirror a pane's REAL terminal (colors, TUI, keyboard, resize) over a Unix socket — the live screen of the Overclock Bot. Returns {socket, token, cols, rows, framing}; wire format and client recipe: skill oc-mcp. Pane must be attachable:true (pane_list).

tools.name: pane_detach
tools.description: Close pane_attach connections: with `token` only that attachment; without it, every attachment of the pane (socket removed).

token.description: Token returned by pane_attach. Omit to detach all.

tools.name: pane_whoami
tools.description: Identity of THIS pane: paneId, mission, workspace, cwd, who spawned it (null = opened by the human), role and harness. The handshake already carries it — call only if unsure.

tools.name: overclock_list
tools.description: List one kind of resource: models, agents, skills (catalog), providers (spawnable CLIs/accounts), vault (media assets) or media_providers (configured image/video/audio services). `query`/`area` filter; `name` with kind=agents returns that agent in full.

kind.description: REQUIRED family: models | agents | skills | providers | vault | media_providers.

name.description: Agents: return this one agent in full.

cli.description: Agents (with name): which CLI's installation to read.

family.description: media_providers: only one media family — image | video | audio.

tools.name: overclock_mission
tools.description: Overclock missions (the unit that groups panes/tasks): list, get, create, or set_status. Spawns inherit the caller's mission — pass missionId to pane_spawn only to deviate.

limit.description: Optional max missions to return (1-200). Default 12, newest first.

workspacePath.description: Explicit target workspace. Overrides the default (caller workspace).

allWorkspaces.description: List missions across ALL workspaces. Default false: scoped to the caller workspace.

includeArchived.description: Include archived missions. Default false (archived are dead state — F-058).

title.description: Short mission title, e.g. "Implement payment flow".

description.description: Optional mission summary. Helps future model/agent routing.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path of the workspace/worktree of the mission.

type.description: C-195: mission type — decides pane-spawn behavior inside it. Omit for libre (default).

workDir.description: Sticky work directory for ALL file output of the mission. Declare once, before delegating.

tools.name: overclock_media_generate
tools.description: Generate an image, video or audio file with a configured provider (discover them with overclock_list kind=media_providers). Returns the output path.

imageUrl.description: Source image (image-to-image / first frame): http(s) URL or local path.

images.description: Reference images [{url, role}]. image: role character|style|object (google-image honors roles). video (grok-cli): subjects to keep faithful (reference_to_video).

url.description: http(s) URL or local file path (relative paths resolve against the workspace).

provider.description: Provider service id (see overclock_list kind=media_providers). Default: the configured one.

model.description: Model override — one of the provider's active models.

aspect.description: image: aspect ratio (16:9, 9:16, 1:1…). video (grok-cli): applied to the generated frame.

endImageUrl.description: video: end frame (Kling) to interpolate between imageUrl and this.

recoverJobId.description: video: re-poll a prior timed-out job by id instead of submitting.

durationSeconds.description: video (grok-cli): 6 or 10 s (others rounded; `note` says so). replicate-video uses Settings.

voices.description: video (grok-cli): up to 3 preset voice ids (eve, leo, ara…); prompt tags <AUDIO_n>; images are <IMAGE_n>.

tools.name: overclock_navigate
tools.description: Drive the Overclock UI: workspaces, missions, screens, panes, the MissionWizard (`wizard-*`) and dialogs — pick the action with `target` (documented there). `target:"browser"` + `url` opens a URL or a local built site in the internal browser pane (the way to show a deliverable). Query resolution: exact id → exact title → title contains; 0 or 2+ matches never navigate, they return candidates. UI only — panes are pane_spawn/pane_list.

target.description: UI action (enum). workspace-*/mission/pane/screen take `query`; wizard-set takes "key:value,…"; browser takes `url`; skin `query`=skin id; workspace-add `query`=absolute path. Details: skill oc-mcp.

query.description: Workspace path/name, mission id/title, screen name, pane id/title, squad preset id, tab index, or "key:value" for wizard-set.

goal.description: run-agentic: goal pre-filled in the wizard.

url.description: For target=browser: http(s) URL or ABSOLUTE local path of a built site (served automatically).

missionId.description: For target=browser: mission to attach the pane to (default: caller's).

create.description: workspace-add: create the folder when missing.

tools.name: overclock_status
tools.description: Is the app running, which workspace/mission is active, what this connection can do (gated capabilities declared). Call first from an external connector.

tools.name: app_observe
tools.description: JSON tree of what is on screen (workspaces, missions, panes, open dialog with its options). The observation is the decision input; screenshots are proof for humans only. `uiReportStale:true` = renderer not yet reported — observe again.

scope.description: Slice of the tree to return. Default "app" (whole tree).

tools.name: app_events
tools.description: Cursor-based queue of app events (pane finished, handoff, dialog…) — pass `after` = last seq read. `source:"perf"` returns performance episodes instead.

since.description: Seq of the last event you read. Omit on the first call.

last.description: How many episodes to return, most recent first. Default 10, max 500.
